name: Kenji Tanaka
psychographics: Skeptical of marketing claims; prefers minimalism and precision. Dietary needs are a source of social friction, not personal tragedy.
current_solutions: Relies on a custom spreadsheet tracking soy and dairy cross-contamination; uses the 'Ask before you eat' feature in the Japanese app LINE to message restaurants directly. Frequently visits organic supermarkets like Aeon for specific gluten-free mochi brands.
frustration: Tried to order a 'gluten-free' ramen bowl at a busy izakaya in Nakazaki-cho at 12:30pm on Saturday; the staff confirmed it was GF, but the ladle used for the broth had also stirred a wheat-based noodle pot ten minutes prior. Had to leave the restaurant hungry and spent the next four hours in discomfort.
decision_style: asks staff detailed preparation questions; if the staff seems unsure, walks out immediately
voice: rambling and detail-obsessed; frequently apologizes for inconveniencing staff, uses Japanese honorifics mixed with English technical terms like "kantan" (easy) and "fu" (wheat)
